{{Top|leg}}
A '''war party''' (plural '''war parties''') was a military unit among the [[Warrior caste]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. War parties would vary in size according the mission profile of the party, but their numbers could range from anywhere to half a dozen to two dozen.

==Appearances==
*''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''
